preconditions.description: The number of town attractions N must be a natural number between 3 and 20 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= stdout[i][j] <= 1000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
postconditions.description: All prices in the adjacency matrix must be non-negative and not greater than 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i][j] == 0 for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i == j)
postconditions.description: The diagonal elements of the adjacency matrix must be zero.

postconditions.expression: len(set(stdout[i][j] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)) == N * (N - 1) // 2
postconditions.description: All off-diagonal prices in the adjacency matrix must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(stdout[i][j] for j in range(N)) == sum(stdout[k][j] for j in range(N)) for i in range(N) for k in range(N))
postconditions.description: The total price of any city sightseeing tour must be the same for all tours.
